commits.summary: One Langfuse command for several sessions, and a session with nothing to send stops being reported
Verification queue priorities: move committed jobs up or down later, and run only the top of the queue
Record the user's decisions on the sound-verdicts brief's open items, and queue the job one of them waits on
A relative --jbmc path is found, and --details prints the statement and the time under a verdict
Benchmark group 2 reviewed by the user: the midpoint regression's scope tightened, the checksum property's note corrected
The own checker makes a division or product of equal operands one value: a functional-consistency lemma before any circuit is built
Confirming a proof that rests on contracts: under --confirm, JBMC applies the own checker's contracts at the same calls and proves it again
The end-of-turn hook leaves a session that wrote no transcript unmarked, so check stops warning about it
Pipeline jobs apply git-format patches: git in a job no longer takes this repository for the job's, and a skipped file fails the patch stage
Record verification results for 2 jobs: the benchmark's per-phase table, and the JBMC reader differential, which agreed but failed on unapplied patches
Queue the JBMC reader differential for the five examples whose patches went unapplied (verification pending)
Record verification results for 2 jobs: JBMC's two readings agree on every recorded JBMC example, and JBMC's own gaps reach only 013 and 071

prompts.text: Review results of the latest feature loop run and let's go through user actions left by it
Propose all 6 allow list entries, then signal for my approval. Patch Langfuse sync to enable multiple ids passed in to a single command, then share the command with me.
Note: I've run both commands, do a quick check on your end. For verification jobs, enhance the process so we can prioritize certain jobs, then let's run the ones with work waiting on them -- provide…
Walk me through recorded decisions that need my action interactively one-by-one, summarizing any tradeoffs
Interactively walk me through the group 2 review sheet, then we'll implement 1 and 2
Eror on Langfuse sync: cdc1176b-c9e4-4032-ba48-013fe392e890: nothing to send, no transcript on this machine and no stored log
Continue with commits as outlined then push all changes to remote
Two priority jobs are finished (-073804 and -102624), analyze their results and recommend next steps
Next steps are good, proceed with proposed order
I've approved the sync in another terminal. The priority verification jobs are complete, analyze and consider latest results again, then push all changes to remote
